FieldDescription: Primary key indentifer of the line of data in our analytical tool
Project code
Price quote (PQ) number
FieldNotes: "Pre-PQ Process" indicates deliveries that occurred before the PQ process was put in place in mid-2009.

FieldDescription: Order number: Purchase order (PO) for Direct Drop deliveries, or Sales Order (SO) for from Regional Delivery Center (RDC) deliveries
FieldNotes: PO # is not applicable for from RDC deliveries ("NA - From RDC")

FieldDescription: Shipment number: Advanced Shipment Note (ASN) for Direct Drop deliveries, or Delivery Note (DN) for from RDC deliveries
Destination country
SCMS managing office: either the Program Management Office (PMO) in the U.S. or the relevant SCMS field office
Method through which the shipment was fulfilled: via Direct Drop from vendor or from stock available in the RDCs
The vendor INCO term (also known as International Commercial Terms) for Direct Drop deliveries
FieldNotes: Not applicable for from RDC deliveries ("NA - From RDC")

FieldDescription: Method by which commodities are shipped

FieldName: PQ First Sent to Client Date
FieldDescription: Date the PQ is first sent to the client
FieldNotes: "Pre-PQ Process" indicates deliveries that occurred before the PQ process was put in place in mid-2009.  "Date Not Captured" where date was not captured.

FieldDescription: Date the PO is first sent to the vendor
FieldNotes: Not applicable for from RDC deliveries ("NA - From RDC"). "Date Not Captured" where date was not captured.

FieldDescription: Current anticipated delivery date
FieldNotes: This date is not equivalent to the client promised delivery date and should not be used to determine on-time perform.

FieldDescription: Date of delivery to client
FieldNotes: Transactions are included in the dataset only after the goods have been delivered to the client

FieldDescription: Date on which delivery to client was recorded in SCMS information systems
FieldNotes: This date is used for official SCMS reporting. Deliveries are only recorded in SCMS systems once all necessary documentation has been received. Due to documentation delays there can be a lag between the time goods are physically delivered to the client and the date on which all necessary documentation has been received.

FieldDescription: Product group for item, i.e. ARV, HRDT
FieldNotes: ACT, ANTM, ARV, HRDT, MRDT only

FieldDescription: Identifies relevant product sub classifications, such as whether ARVs are pediatric or adult, whether a malaria product is an artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT), etc.
Vendor name
FieldNotes: SCMS is the vendor for from RDC deliveries (product can be from multiple manufacturers, based on available stock)

FieldDescription: Product name and formulation from Partnership for Supply Chain Management (PFSCM) Item Master
Active drug(s) or test kit type
Generic or branded name for the item
Item dosage and unit
Dosage form for the item (tablet, oral solution, injection, etc.).
FieldNotes: "FDC" denotes if the item contains a fixed-dose combination (FDC) formulation. "Blister" denotes if the item is presented in blister packaging. "Co-blister" denotes when the item contains more than one product packaged together in blister packaging.

FieldDescription: Pack quantity (pills or test kits) used to compute unit price
Total quantity (packs) of commodity per line item
Total value of commodity per line item
Cost per pack (i.e. month's supply of ARVs, pack of 60 test kits)
Cost per pill (for drugs) or per test (for test kits)
Identifies manufacturing site for the line item for direct drop and from RDC deliveries
Designates if the line in question shows the aggregated freight costs and weight associated with all items on the ASN/DN
FieldNotes: There may or may not be other associated lines with each ASN/DN

FieldDescription: Weight for all lines on an ASN/DN
FieldNotes: Present only for FirstLine designated lines

FieldDescription: Freight charges associated with all lines on the respective ASN/DN
FieldNotes: Present only for FirstLine designated lines. For C- and D-vendor INCO term deliveries, freight costs may be included in the unit price for the commodities as indicated by "Freight Included in Commodity Price". All other lines are "Invoiced Separately"

FieldDescription: Line item cost of insurance, created by applying an annual flat rate (%) to commodity cost
FieldNotes: Pre 6/1/2009 lines are still under analysis for correct rates because they do not have PQs and cannot be computed in the same way that they currently are across the partnership
